content.short: Dextrabot offers Hyperliquid trading bots including copy trading, grid bots and market makers.
content.description: Dextrabot finds high-performing wallets on Hyperliquid and Lighter, reports their track record and then copies their perpetual trades at the user's own size, stop-loss and take-profit. Filters surface overlooked performers rather than only the largest accounts, and a wallet analyser breaks down any address on demand. Copy trades carry a 0.055 percent fee, alerts arrive over Telegram, and a multi-level referral program pays up to 65 percent.
content.meta: Copy trading, grid bots and market making run against Hyperliquid's public positions.
